scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: Beyond States: Investigating the Effects of Context on User Modeling with Feature-Conditioned Markov Models
papers.authors: Friese, Jana Isabelle, Kruff, Andreas Konstantin, Breuer, Timo, Schaer, Philipp, Fuhr, Norbert
papers.abstract: User behavior simulation is widely used to evaluate interactive information retrieval systems, but classical state-based approaches (e.g., Markov models) have limited ability to incorporate contextual information relevant for decision-making. We address this limitation by introducing a feature-conditioned Markov-style user model, in which transition probabilities are modeled as functions of positional, content-based, and interaction-derived features, enabling context-aware decision making while preserving the structural simplicity and computational efficiency of state-based models. Applying a multi-level framework that assesses predictive fit and behavioral fidelity, we analyze how different sources of contextual information contribute to realistic user simulation across multiple datasets, search settings, and feature configurations. Our results show that incorporating contextual features improves the models' ability to reproduce key aspects of real user interactions, but that their effectiveness hinges on search scenario and modeling objective. Instead of a one-size-fits-all solution, effective simulation requires task- and setting-specific feature selection. Our framework provides a practical and interpretable basis for making these choices.
papers.summary: 论文将马尔可夫用户模型的状态转移概率改为位置、内容和交互特征的函数，评估上下文对搜索行为模拟的影响。在 TREC 上，位置特征将点击召回从 0.31 提高至 0.38、准确率从 0.79 提高至 0.84；LISP 点击召回从 0.33 提高至 0.44，但时间行为的最优特征组合不同。
papers.key_insight: 社区 UGC 搜索可借鉴这种轻量、可解释的用户行为模拟方法，为排序方案提供辅助评估。应分别验证点击文档重合、会话时间和结果质量，避免把点击预测更准直接解释为用户体验更好；随机结果列表中的内容信号也不能由位置特征替代。

papers.title: DP-Rec: Towards Dynamic Patching for Efficient Long-Sequence Recommendation
papers.authors: Katariya, Dwipam, Caputo, Thomas, Shreemali, Akshat, Origgi, Juan Manuel, Seleznev, Nikita, Mohanty, Pranab, Mishra, Kalanand, Nguyen, Nam, Montgomery, James
papers.abstract: Transformers have redefined sequential recommendation by effectively modeling dynamic user behaviors and long-range dependencies. However, they remain inherently inefficient: standard architectures operate at a fixed rate, allocating comparable computation to every item in a user's history regardless of its information content. This leads to prohibitive computational overhead on long sequences and increased sensitivity to behavioral noise. To address this, practitioners often resort to lossy sequence compression, staged modeling, or truncation. This limits the model's ability to leverage the full context of long histories during inference. Inspired by the recent success of Byte Latent Transformer, we propose DP-Rec, a dynamic latent patching architecture for recommendation. DP-Rec shifts from item-level modeling to patch-level modeling by segmenting interaction sequences using contrastive entropy surprise to identify informative behavioral boundaries. A lightweight patch encoder compresses these temporally contextualized segments into a reduced set of dynamic latent behavior vectors, which are then processed by a larger latent transformer and decoded for next-item prediction. Extensive experiments show that, under constrained computational budgets, DP-Rec scales effectively to long sequences and achieves a superior efficiency-accuracy trade-off over both non-compressed and fixed-size compression baselines.
papers.summary: DP-Rec 按行为变化动态切分长用户序列，用局部编码器压缩片段，再由潜在 Transformer 建模。计算预算对齐实验中，ML-1M 的 NDCG@10 为 0.2523，对比 SASRec 的 0.2176；ML-10M-L 和 KuaiRand 相对最强基线分别提升 21.1% 和 11.0%，主结果覆盖 10 个随机种子。
papers.key_insight: 对社区帖子、问答和评论的个性化排序，可先测试动态压缩是否比截断历史保留更多长期兴趣。作者使用时间感知位置编码与冻结边界检测器，适合分阶段试验；论文也明确指出 FLOPs 节省尚不能直接等同于实际吞吐提升，生产采用前仍须测量尾延迟和聚合算子开销。

papers.title: OT-FlowRec: Optimal Transport-Guided Multi-Bridge Flow for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
papers.abstract: E-commerce user preferences evolve dynamically within sessions, exhibiting concurrent and multi-centric interest distributions. While existing multimodal sequential recommendation methods leverage global attention to compress historical interactions, they inadequately capture the concurrent nature of multi-interest behaviors and fail to model the underlying multi-centric distribution of user intent. To tackle this issue, we propose OT-FlowRec, an optimal transport-guided multi-bridge flow matching framework that explicitly models multi-interest distributions to facilitate multimodal sequential recommendation. Unlike single-path generative models, OT-FlowRec constructs a mixture of parallel, interest-specific transport flows to model the multi-centric distribution characteristics, where each flow preserves a distinct user interest cluster via an optimal transport plan. Then, a geometric transport mechanism is designed to establish minimum-cost paths from the latent multi-interest distribution to target preference prototypes to provide multi-interest awareness. Moreover, a progressive time-sampling warmup strategy dynamically biases optimization weights toward the final states of the generation process, bridging the gap between continuous global distribution fitting and practical top-$k$ ranking metrics. This approach achieves explicit interest disentanglement, ensuring the preservation of a multi-peaked preference representation instead of collapsing it into a unimodal average. Extensive experiments on three public datasets demonstrate that OT-FlowRec outperforms existing state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary: OT-FlowRec 针对单向量压缩造成的多兴趣坍缩，结合多原型、最优传输引导的并行流及渐进时间采样。在 Amazon 三个数据集上，Beauty 的 H@20 达到 0.1267、NDCG@20 达到 0.0537；Video Games 的 NDCG@20 为 0.0780，对比 ADRec 的 0.0705，结果为离线实验。
papers.key_insight: 社区用户可能同时关注多个主题，可借鉴按兴趣保留多个表征并取最大匹配分的设计，而非立即替换整个搜索排序链路。本文核心问题是多兴趣用户建模，因而归入个性化；社区短文本场景仍需验证原型稳定性、内容噪声，以及六步 ODE 推断带来的延迟。

papers.title: Polarization Dynamics under Algorithmic Recommendations in LLM-based Online Social Networks
papers.authors: Dehkordi, Ali Safarpoor, Shirzadi, Mohammad, Nasim, Mehwish, Zehmakan, Ahad N.
papers.abstract:
How do recommendation algorithms contribute to the formation of polarized opinions in online social networks? This question has been studied through empirical analyses of real platforms and mathematical models of opinion dynamics. Empirical studies capture user behavior but are often limited by noisy, incomplete, or inaccessible platform data, while mathematical models offer control and interpretability but usually rely on simplified opinion update rules. More recently, large language model (LLM)-based social simulations have provided an alternative for studying recommendation and opinion dynamics through natural-language interactions. However, how different ways of applying recommendations shape opinion dynamics remains underexplored.
 In this work, we provide a controlled comparison of two different recommendation mechanisms in an LLM-based online social network simulation. Edge Recommendation (ER) introduces new connections in the network, while Content-Exposure Recommendation (CR) exposes additional users to individual posts without modifying the underlying graph. Our framework represents users as LLM-based agents who interact in natural language while maintaining evolving opinion states. We measure polarization as opinion dispersion, extremization as the average distance of opinions from the neutral midpoint, and reinforcement as interactions that amplify already aligned opinions. Our results show higher mean polarization and extremization across recommendation conditions compared with the no-recommendation baseline, with absolute differences of up to $0.12$ in our main experiments.
papers.summary: 论文在 LLM 在线社交网络模拟中比较两类推荐机制：新增社交边，以及只扩大帖子的内容曝光。模型跟踪用户观点随自然语言交互的演化，以观点离散度、极端化和强化效应衡量影响；主要实验中，推荐相对无推荐基线的指标绝对差值最高达到 0.12，但这些数字来自模拟环境。
papers.key_insight: UGC 社区的多目标排序不宜只看 CTR，还可把观点集中与重复曝光作为独立观察维度。应区分推荐新关系和推荐新内容的作用路径，并用真实用户行为校准模拟器；本文不能直接证明线上推荐的因果效果，更不能把模拟的 0.12 差异作为生产系统预期收益。

papers.title: A NeuMF-Based Framework for Sparse E-Commerce Recommendation with Cold-Start Fallback
papers.abstract: NeuMF结合GMF与MLP，针对稀疏电商推荐和冷启动增加回退策略。
papers.summary: 研究将 GMF 与 MLP 组合的 NeuMF 用于稀疏电商推荐，并为完全未见用户提供热门物品回退。在 Amazon Electronics 上，变体 MAE 为 0.8603，低于原版的 0.8837，但 RMSE 为 1.2362，差于原版的 1.2172；NDCG@10 差异不显著，全库排序中 LightGCN 最强。
papers.key_insight: 社区新用户排序可把热门回退作为可验证的保底方案，同时单独评估已有用户、稀疏用户与完全新用户。更低评分误差没有保证更好的 Top-K 排序，该研究适合用来设计基线及验收协议；是否引入归一化和 Dropout，应由社区 nDCG 与 CTR 实验决定。

papers.title: Lifecycle-evolving recommendation with adaptive strategy transition for smart learning
papers.abstract: Lifecycle-evolving recommendation with adaptive strategy transition for smart learning
papers.summary: 研究按用户成熟度在冷启动与成熟推荐策略之间连续过渡：前期使用可观测行为的朴素贝叶斯分类，后期使用带显著性加权相似度的 SVD。在 EdNet 上，Precision@16 为 0.143、Recall@16 为 0.237、NDCG@16 为 0.202，相比用户协同过滤的 NDCG 提升 4.7%。
papers.key_insight: 社区新用户往往经历从少量点击到稳定兴趣的过程，可借鉴连续调整策略权重的设计，减少一次性切换造成的结果突变。本文来自教育资源推荐，与 UGC 搜索存在领域差异；实际试验应按历史行为量分桶，同时观察新用户 CTR、结果相关性与过渡阶段的稳定性。
